stories.headline: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
stories.summary: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.
stories.imageAlt: SpaceX Starship Ship 42 is caught in the arms of the launch tower as it returns from flight on November 14, 2026 in Starbase, Texas.

stories.headline: Nine quick fixes for family tech problems this holiday season
stories.summary: Home for the holidays? These steps will help you solve technology problems your family might be having and prevent crises before they happen. They'll make your life better too.

stories.headline: Black Friday ‘deals’ can be a rip off. Here’s how to spot bogus bargains
stories.summary: Online 'deals' can often not be as good as they first seem and actually cost you more. But there are some easy ways to spot slippery pricing.
stories.imageAlt: A shopping trolley holding sale signs is pushed through the screen of a smartphone by a person's index finger gently touching the handle (Credit: BBC/ Serenity Strull/ Getty Images)

stories.headline: The AI bubble could expose your deepest secrets
stories.summary: Character.ai's collapse uncovers a little-discussed risk of AI: when tech companies go bankrupt, they can sell your private data.
stories.imageAlt: The hands of two people exchanging wads of cash for a phone with a password lock (Credit: BBC/ Serenity Strull/ Getty Images)
